headline: Fisherman’s Row Leads Renewed Base Fighting
war_summary: The latest ledger puts Fisherman’s Row at the head of the active base fronts, with five ownership events in the past two hours and six in six, leaving seven Warden holdings against two Colonial. Godcrofts has cooled from its earlier burst but still records eight events in six hours; eight Warden bases remain held, with one position neutral. Deadlands remains unsettled at three Warden and eight Colonial bases, posting five events in six hours and 18 across the day amid very heavy losses on both sides. Lykos Isle retains a divided four-to-three count and six daily events, while its casualty and enlistment rates are accelerating in the latest comparison. Farranac Coast, previously a point of movement, shows no fresh event in two hours and three over 24, with nine Colonial bases to two Warden. The heaviest current fighting by casualties is in Weathered Expanse and Clahstra, joined by a sharp surge in Stlican Shelf; none has recorded a base event in the reported windows. Elsewhere, most sectors remain quiet or firmly held.
